description: One Indiana opinion cluster by CourtListener cluster id. Includes opinion text only when the collection has a body; attribution names its source. Includes author when that index is loaded: the slip byline, not the trial judge and not a holding. version_signal is a caution (yellow / red / year banner), never a green certified mark. When paragraph links are loaded, paragraphs says whether this opinion has them (only opinions whose court-printed paragraph numbers run unbroken from 1). paragraph (optional: a number such as 12, or a range such as "12-14", at most 10) returns just those numbered paragraphs, each with its number and its start and end offsets in the full text, cited as ¶ 12.
name: case_get
title: Get an Indiana case cluster
